paite: Huchi in ka en a, ngai in, cherubte lutung a vansin om ah sapphir suang hileh kilawmtak, laltutphah bangtak a kimu ahong lang hi.
heading: Pathian Thupina In Tempul Anusia
english: Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

paite: Ama'n puanmalngat silhpa kiang ah, "Cherub nuai a kangtalai peite kikal ah va lut inla, cherubte kikal a meivu na khut langnih dim in va luak inla, khopi tung ah thehzak in," achi hi.
english: He spoke to the man clothed in linen, and said, “Go in between the whirling wheels, even under the cherub, and fill both your hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.” He went in as I watched.

paite: Ka mitmuh lai mahmah in akuanta hi. Huan mi ahoh lai in tempul taklam pang ah cherubte adingh ua; huang sungnungpen meipi in adimta hi.
english: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.

paite: TOUPA thupina cherubte a kipan apaitou a, inn kongpi tung ah ava dinghta a, huai inn meipi in adim a, TOUPA thupina vak in huangsung adimta hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory mounted up from the cherub, and stood over the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of Yahweh’s glory.

paite: Cherubte khazap gingte huangsung ponungzaw leng Pathian Bangkim hihthei in ahon houpih lai a a-om bang mai in akiza hi.
english: The sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, puanmalngat silhpa kiang ah, "Cherubte kikal a kangtalai pei kikal a kipan mei va la in," chi a thu apiakleh, amah ava lut a, kangtalai liimte bul ah ava dinghta hi.
english: It came to pass, when he commanded the man clothed in linen, saying, “Take fire from between the whirling wheels, from between the cherubim,” that he went in and stood beside a wheel.

paite: Huan cherubim, cherubte kikal a kipan in, cherubte kikal a mei om sawk in, ala a, puanmalngat silhpa khut ah apia a, ama'n ana la a, apawtkheta hi.
english: The cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire that was between the cherubim, and took some of it, and put it into the hands of him who was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.

paite: Huchi in cherubte bel akha nuai uah mihing khut bangtak ahong lang a.
english: The form of a man’s hand appeared here in the cherubim under their wings.

paite: Huan ka en a, ngai in, cherubte sik ah kangtalai liim li, cherub khat kiang ah, kangtalai liim khat, cherub dang kiang ah kangtalai liim dang ka mu a; kangtalai liim latdan bel beril suang zia bang ahi.
english: I looked, and behold, there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub. The appearance of the wheels was like a beryl stone.

paite: Alatdan un ali un kibatna khat anei ua, kangtalai liim khat sung a kangtalai liim dang om bang mai ahi hi.
english: As for their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, like a wheel within a wheel.

paite: Apai chiang un sik li in apai thei ua, apai un leng akihei ngei kei uh; himahleh amasa ngatna lam azui zel ua, apai un akihei tuan kei uh.
english: When they went, they went in their four directions. They didn’t turn as they went, but to the place where the head looked they followed it. They didn’t turn as they went.

paite: Huan apumpi uh apum in anungte uh, akhutte uh, akhate uleh kangtalai liimte leng akim in mit in adim a, ali ua kangtalai liimte leng.
english: Their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, even the wheels that the four of them had.

paite: Akangtalai liimte bil a ka zak mahmah in, "Kangtalai liimte kipei," chih ahi.
english: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing, “the whirling wheels”.

paite: Michih in mel li chiat anei ua, mel khat cherub mel ahi a, anihna mihing mel ahi a, athumna humpinelkai mel, alina muvanlai mel ahi.
english: Every one of them had four faces. The first face was the face of the cherub. The second face was the face of a man. The third face was the face of a lion. The fourth was the face of an eagle.

paite: Huchi in cherubte apaitou ua; hiai bel Kebar lui gei a thil hing ka muh ahi.
english: The cherubim mounted up. This is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.

paite: Huan cherubte apai uleh kangtalai liimte leng agei uah apai tei a, cherubte'n lei a kipan paitou ding a akhate uh azak uleh kangtalai liimte'n alehngatsan ngei kei uh.
english: When the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the wheels also didn’t turn from beside them.

paite: Adin uleh hiaite adingh tei ua, apaitouh uleh hiaite leng apai tei zel ua, thil hingte kha amau ah a-om hi.
english: When they stood, these stood. When they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.

paite: TOUPA thupina inpi kongpi tung a kipan apawtkhia a, cherubte tung ah adinghta hi.
english: Yahweh’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house and stood over the cherubim.

paite: Huan cherubte'n akha uh azak ua, apawt un ka mitmuh mahmah in lei a kipan apaitou ua; kangtalai liimte akiang uah a-om zel a; huan TOUPA Inn lutna suahlam kongkhak chin ah adinghta a; Israel' Pathian thupina atung uah a-om hi.
english: The cherubim lifted up their wings and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels beside them. Then they stood at the door of the east gate of Yahweh’s house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.

paite: Hiai bel Kebar lui a Israel' Pathian nuai a ka thil hing muh mah ahi; cherubte ahi uh chih ka thei hi.
english: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.

paite: Avek un maitang li leh kha li anei chiat ua, akha nuai uah mihing khut bang mai a-om hi.
english: Every one had four faces, and every one four wings. The likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.

paite: Huan amel lam uh ahihleh Kebar lui a ka muh melte mah bang, alatdan uleh amau mahmah leng ahi uh; huan amazawn zel uah apai chiat uhi.
english: As for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves. They each went straight forward.
